llm.summary: This skill's requirements, instructions, and capabilities align well with its stated purpose of helping users write cinematic scripts and manage related creative content.

dimensions.detail: The skill focuses on cinematic script writing, character consistency, cinematography guidance, and related storage features, all consistent with its description. Required tools like node and npm for installation are reasonable for this type of skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions direct usage of a CLI tool for managing story contexts, generating scripts, managing cinematography references, and saving scripts to Google Drive or local storage. They do not ask for unrelated system files or environment variables and stay within the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is installed through a well-known package manager (npm) via the openclaw-skills package. There are no downloads from unknown URLs or unusual installation steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or credentials are declared as required by the skill, which matches the instruction-only nature and Google Drive OAuth2 handled dynamically. This is proportionate for the functionality described.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not set to always be active and allows model invocation by default, which is normal for a creative skill. It does not request broad permanent access or privileged presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be exactly what it says: an advanced tool to help write cinematic scripts with useful features for character and cinematography management. It does not ask for unnecessary credentials or perform actions beyond its purpose. You can consider installing it if you want help with creative script writing and related video production guidance.
